prose: The Financial Times reports, via sources, that Nvidia is in talks to acquire or increase its investment in Reflection AI, a US open-weights AI startup, in a deal that may be structured as an acquihire to avoid antitrust scrutiny.

The Trump administration hopes the company will rival cheap Chinese alternatives such as DeepSeek. Basis: the FT page is paywalled and was not fetched in this pass, so this rests on the headline and Techmeme's excerpt.
highlights: Nvidia talks to buy or deepen stake in Reflection AI
Possible acquihire structure to skirt antitrust review
Framed as a US answer to DeepSeek
